desktop.notesZh: Phase 7：baseline 驱动的质量门（StackAdapter/QualityReport 占位）+ 工具调用硬门禁（baf-guard：结构路径裁决 + 同步 projection 读 + 密钥扫描，按 mode/adjudicate 拦截）+ 工作区脚手架（baf-scaffold：基线模板 + openspec 目录，人工确认与备份语义）
desktop.notesEn: Phase 7: baseline-driven quality gate (StackAdapter / QualityReport placeholders) + tool-call hard gate (baf-guard: structural path adjudication + sync projection reads + secret scan, per-mode/adjudicate denial) + workspace scaffold (baf-scaffold: baseline template + openspec layout with human confirmation and backup semantics)
